title: Code and data for: Positivity of Single-Centred Black Hole Indices in the Z2 CHL Model
description: LaTeX source, PDF, exact-arithmetic orbit computation and ball-arithmetic certificates for the paper on Sen's positivity conjecture for single-centred black hole indices of the Z2 CHL model. Positivity is proved for Q^2 <= 2 and for every charge of discriminant at most 800, and for all charges under an explicit level-two Rademacher hypothesis.
